description: Shift CDC/logical-replication pipeline for analytics: set up logical replication slot on production PostgreSQL 14, capture WAL changes, replicate to analytics warehouse (Snowflake), backfill historical data via snapshot, then cutover the analytics consumers from batch ETL to CDC stream. Must verify lag < 5s before cutover, ensure no data loss during backfill-to-stream transition, and maintain idempotency for replay. Risk factors: replication slot bloat if consumer lags, schema changes during backfill break the stream, cutover gap where events are missed between backfill snapshot and stream start. Tools available: pglogical, Debezium, Kafka Connect, Snowpipe, kubectl, CI/CD.
